title: Volume 2 Chapter 2: Her Friend Who Knows the Situation Comes On Strong
content: Chapter 2: Her Friend Who Knows the Situation Comes On Strong
"—Iori-kun, is it okay if I sit next to you?"
Kuzunoha Mahiro approached me before class on the very day the one-week ban on her getting close to me ended.
Today, as always, she had her Ash Greige hair styled in soft, flowing long locks, perfectly paired with a news anchor-like outfit, exuding a clean yet somewhat cunning vibe.
As she seemed to target me, a non-virgin, a buzz spread through the large lecture hall, especially among those who seemed to know her reputation.
"Eh, no way."
My single word of rejection only amplified the commotion.
Kuzunoha let out a sound that was hard to describe, then turned her gaze to the seat next to me, blooming into a smile like a flower.
"Hey, Kamiya-kun?"
"Ah, yeah, what is it, Kuzunoha-san?"
"Hey, stop that. Kamiya has nothing to do with this."
Kuzunoha, who had sneakily set her sights on my friend Kamiya Daisuke (a virgin), continued without heeding my words of restraint.
"Could you let me sit there? I'll thank you later."
"Sure, go ahead."
"Wait, Kuzunoha. Don't mess with my friends; you can sit next to me."
I hurriedly cleared the edge of the four-person desk that we were using.
I tossed my bag at my feet, arranging it so that Kamiya was on my left, then me, followed by Kuzunoha's bag, and finally Kuzunoha herself.
"Ah, is that okay? Thanks!"
"How insincere...!"
As I gritted my teeth in frustration, Kuzunoha was taking out her pencil case with a face that looked like she had just gotten a seat for free, which only made me angrier.
"—Hey, Shino-chi."
"I get what you want to say, Kamiya. But no."
Sure, Kuzunoha was a bit of a cute beauty, but I wouldn't say she was as stunning as Tsukasa.
That aside, she openly admitted to being a monster that devours virgins, and I couldn't just stand by and watch my friend fall prey to her fangs.
"Someday, someday, Kamiya will surely have a cute girlfriend. But today is not that day."
In fact, I thought it would be better for him to avoid Kuzunoha as his first girlfriend. Seriously.
"But you know..."
You should calm down.
Even if you got close to Kuzunoha and started dating, you'd probably be dumped in less than a month like Umehara, and then you'd end up judging all girls based on your ex.
That's just miserable.
"Iori-kun, is it bad manners to point at people?"
"Ah, sorry."
"Ume, huh... That makes me a bit uneasy."
Kamiya's expression turned pained at the mention of a former friend from our department, who now sported an ill-suited blonde hair and was overly enthusiastic about hitting on girls.
He was probably reminiscing about the days when we used to casually chat about being unpopular.
Those days that would never return.
"I see, that's true—no, but it still hurts. Shino-chi is fine because she has Tsukasa-san."
Still, Kamiya seemed unwilling to give up.
I understood his argument, especially since I was dating a top-tier beauty like Tsukasa (a politically incorrect statement).
"I'll ask Tsukasa-san if I can introduce you to some friends next time."
"Really?"
"…Really."
Though I said that, I wondered if I could just introduce Kuzunoha to Kamiya as a shield against her advances...
When it comes to romance, especially with someone else involved, I had no idea how Tsukasa would react.
"By the way, does Tsukasa-san have any female friends?"
"Yeah, a few?" That was the same impression I had back in the day...
"I see, then I’d rather have a gal who's kind to otaku."
"Well, I don't think there are any like that..."
I wondered if such a girl even existed.
"Well, just don't expect too much."
"That's better than having no hope at all! Man, having a friend with a girlfriend is the best!"
Among the many friends who changed their attitudes after I started dating Tsukasa, Kamiya was truly a good person.
I couldn't understand why he wasn't popular with girls (a common male friend assessment).
"Hehe, you two are really close."
And why was Kuzunoha in such a good mood?
It sent a slight chill down my spine; I really couldn't figure out what would tickle this soft monster's fancy...
"Oh, by the way. Do you both want some snacks? Here, they’re autumn limited chestnut-flavored and really good!"
"Eh, what’s with the sudden offer?"
"Just try them, okay?"
Overwhelmed by Kuzunoha's insistence as she pushed a stick-shaped chocolate snack toward me, I reluctantly took one.
"Yeah. It's pretty good."
"Ah, I like this one. It has a Mont Blanc-like taste, right?"
"Right? Kamiya-kun, you should have another one."
Ah, okay...
By the way, did something happen between you and Shino-chi?
You two haven't really interacted before, have you?
Well, it's a bit hard to explain... but I guess it's because she's Tsukasa-san's friend.
I don't know why Kuzunoha is being so whimsical.
"Eh? It's not whimsy! I’m actually asking Iori-kun if he wants to go out with me, you know? Right?"
My thoughts about the situation, which I couldn't quite grasp, were easily shattered by Kuzunoha's straightforward explanation.
"Huh?"
Kamiya's expression turned bewildered, as if he was facing the cosmos. I thought that was a perfectly valid reaction.
"If that conversation wasn't over, can I just consider you as someone else?"
"Ah, right, it started from being friends. Sorry about that."
Haha, this was definitely intentional, wasn't it?
And the fact that it started from being friends means she still hasn't given up.
As I raised my mental alertness, Kamiya rebooted.
"Eh, is Tsukasa-san going to get mad about this? Is it okay?"
Ah, Kuzunoha talking to me is something Tsukasa-san knows about.
We had a one-week ban on getting close, but she reached out right after it ended.
"—I really don't get this."
For a while, Kamiya kept repeating,
"I just don't understand girls,
" and unfortunately, there were no kind gals for otaku among Tsukasa's friends.
Mmm, mmm.
"So, were you okay in the end?"
"Yeah, I didn't let Kamiya have any contact afterward, and I made sure to warn Kuzunoha, so it should be fine."
"What I'm worried about is Iori-kun... Why not have Kamiya-kun date Mahiro instead? It might actually go well!"
I don't want to be the kind of guy who uses 'might' to throw my friends into a bungee jump without a cord, Tsukasa-san.
"Is it that serious? I think trying to date a girl at least once, even if it doesn't work out, isn't a bad thing..."
Mmm, mmm.
That might be true in general, but I don't think that's the case this time.
Dating someone like her would warp your preferences in an instant.
There was also the actual example of Umehara.
After all, the opinions of experienced people saying, "It's not that big of a deal" are often unreliable.
Encountering the unknown is always a tough situation (from experience).
"Sure, Mahiro's tastes are a bit unusual, but..."
"A bit?"
"…They're quite unusual, but I don't think it's that dangerous."
"Can you say that while looking me in the eye?"
"Sure, but if you want to kiss me, you'll have to take responsibility."
"That sounds like a wild animal that bites when its eyes meet..."
Was that a sudden regression to ancestral behavior?
I wished she would consider the time and place; how many people were watching us (shudder).
Mmm, mmm.
"…Sorry, Tsukasa-san. Can I check my phone for a moment?"
"Of course."
Finally reaching my limit of ignoring it, I took out my phone, which had been vibrating continuously, checked the notifications, and smoothly set it to silent mode.
Got it!
Now, back to the topic.
I really think that barging into a private moment with my girlfriend and starting to send secret messages makes you a dangerous person.
I pointed my thumb at Kuzunoha, who had come over to our table and was secretly sending messages without joining the conversation.
"Eh, well, if I don't do this, Iori-kun will ignore me, so what else can I do?"
"No, if you just talked to me normally, I wouldn't ignore you."
However, Kuzunoha showed no signs of remorse and stuck out her tongue with a "teehee."
So cunning. I was already regretting exchanging contact information...
"Mahiro, you're not sending anything weird, like risqué selfies, are you?"
I wouldn't do anything that dangerous.
Oh, I mean, it's not that I think you're going to spread it, but there are risks like dropping it or someone peeking at your phone, you know?
"Well, that's fine, but it's just common sense."
What was with this high level of literacy regarding risqué selfies from both Tsukasa and Kuzunoha?
Did something happen in their past?
Well, it's not a bad thing, but I'd be troubled if they sent me something.
But before that, shouldn't the two of them be a bit more concerned about their past relationships being common knowledge on campus?
"Iori-kun, what did Mahiro send you?"
"Ah, just a normal message. Honestly, I'm curious why she even used her phone to contact me."
"Really? Can I borrow it for a moment?"
"Sure..."
I didn't want to be misunderstood, so I showed her the screen, and Tsukasa's interest was piqued more than I expected.
It was a rather rare reaction.
She generally defended me as a friend, but it seemed she also recognized the threat.
I wasn't worried about cheating, but still, I handed over my phone, thinking it was unlikely.
"Iori-kun would accept a cute jealous reaction from his girlfriend, right?"
"Well, if it's just occasionally?"
As usual, my inner thoughts must have shown on my face, as Tsukasa shot me a meaningful glance.
But if she were to get jealous, I'd rather she just keep Kuzunoha away.
Or rather, could I use Tsukasa's attitude as an excuse to reject her?
"Hey, hey, Iori-kun, is there anything you wouldn't want me to see on your phone?"
"Eh? I wouldn't want to show it off, but I guess it's fine if it's you, Tsukasa-san."
The things I really wouldn't want anyone to see are the chat logs with Tsukasa and the existence of a location tracking app.
If it were the person involved, I'd have no choice but to hide everything.
"Well then, can I see yours next?"
"No way. I said it was fine 'if it's Tsukasa-san.'"
"Hey, Iori-kun, you could brag about me to your friends more often, you know?"
"I'd prefer it if you didn't look at logs that aren't related to you."
I wondered if the purpose of the conversation had shifted.
I didn't know what made her say that, but if it were her fiancé back then, it wouldn't have been allowed.
I felt like the order of things was reversed.
"Thanks, that's enough."
"Ah, yeah."
As I received my phone back from Tsukasa, she took my hand and began to play with it, squeezing and stroking it.
My heart rate increased at her soft, smooth hand, but I had grown somewhat accustomed to this slightly lovey-dovey interaction.
Recently, I even found myself feeling a bit fond of it.
"Hehe, you two are really close."
"If you think so, could you please just leave me alone...?"
"That's right. If Mahiro is here, shy Iori-kun won't kiss me."
"Even without Kuzunoha here, I'd prefer to refrain from that."
There were plenty of people around.
Also, the way she said it made it sound like I wanted to flirt with Tsukasa and was trying to keep Kuzunoha away, so I wanted her to stop.
"Eh, you can ignore me, right?"
"I'm the one who wants to pay attention to you."
"Why did Mahiro even play this prank?"
Ah, it seemed like the conversation was finally taking a constructive turn.
Glancing over, Kuzunoha, who was now looking more like a raccoon both inside and out, tilted her head and let out a small
"Hmm.
"Well, I was just curious about what Iori-kun would do with his phone while talking to Tsukasa-chan."
"Could you please stop testing people like that...?"
I wondered if she had taken a class on Christianity. Didn't she know the saying, "Thou shalt not test"?
Maybe Tsukasa should reconsider her friendship with her...
Because, you know, when boys are dating, they start talking while looking at their phones even when they're together, right?
That makes me sad.
"That's more of a personal issue, isn't it?"
It's not about whether you're dating; it varies between friends.
If I glanced at other tables, I'd see pairs tapping away on their phones. What was that about?
Maybe they both just happened to get sudden messages, but in family restaurants, I often saw girls in sweats glued to their phones (a bias).
"Eh? You should understand Tsukasa-chan, right?"
"If it's from experience, Iori-kun, as your first boyfriend, wouldn't do that, so I wouldn't know."
"Eh? Huh?"
"…Why are you surprised, Iori-kun? I was really clear about it with everyone else."
"Ah, okay."
I was a bit surprised that I hadn't had that kind of relationship with other boys, and I received a resentful look.
But still, before that first boyfriend, I had deep relationships with about ninety-eight others!
"Eh, weren't you dating that law student?"
"Ugh."
I wished she would stop digging into the past and delivering collateral damage.
That was a direct attack on me, an instant kill move.
I don't know what you're misunderstanding, but that's not true.
And please stop talking about the past in front of Iori-kun.
Seeing me groan, Tsukasa firmly denied Kuzunoha's words and tightened her grip on my intertwined fingers.
It would be nice if I could casually say I wasn't bothered, but at this point, it would be a lie.
As I pondered what to say, I lightly squeezed Tsukasa's hand back to show that I was still okay (not that I was unscathed).
Eh, I wasn't just saying that randomly!
I really thought so.
Besides, even if it were true, it's not something to hide, right?
"Even so. Unless he wants to hear it, there's no need to share it. Besides, it's a misunderstanding."
Tsukasa's words were straightforward and strong, leaving no room for argument, which made even Kuzunoha drop her airy demeanor.
"Well... Okay, I'm sorry. Iori-kun too."
"…Yeah, well, it's fine. Everyone has their own boundaries, and Kuzunoha probably didn't mean anything by it." Right?
If she did, that would be a bit much, but with her apologizing so openly, it was hard to press further.
I didn't think it was necessary to dig into Tsukasa's past, but I wanted to find a way to avoid being hurt by it.
Still, Kuzunoha, who claimed to like virgins, seemed to have a knack for digging at my heart in a different way...
"Well, if you have questions, I'll ask Tsukasa-san directly. Just remember that."
"Got it, I'll be careful."
"That's right, be careful. Iori-kun is as delicate as a koala."
"That's enough of that."
I didn't want to come off as a tough guy, but emphasizing that I'm fragile is complicated for a guy.
Also, is there a general perception of koalas being delicate?
I only have the impression that they look a bit mean.
Ah, so back to the topic, can I ask one thing?
Why didn't you check your phone right away, Iori-kun?
You didn't know it was from me, right?
"Eh, well, I was talking to Tsukasa-san."
Isn't that obvious?
If something happened to my family, I would have called first, and otherwise, there was no reason to prioritize anyone over the person in front of me.
As I said before, that's a personal issue, right?
I care about that kind of thing, so it probably doesn't change even with friends.
Tsukasa, who also had strict parents, generally left her phone alone while talking.
In fact, I sometimes got told I was rude for being on my phone in other situations.
"Hmm... Tsukasa-chan is nice, I'm so jealous."
Kuzunoha's words fit the description of "wistfully."
Although our relationship was still short, I thought Tsukasa's friend shared a similar awareness, but maybe she hadn't matched well with her ex.
"I'll say it as many times as it takes: Iori-kun is absolutely off-limits."
"Come on, I've never made a move on someone else's boyfriend!"
"Doesn't that come with a 'yet' in front of it?"
Feeling like I had stepped into a snake pit, I tried to change the subject, but just then, the chime rang.
"Alright, it's time. Shall we go?"
"Yeah."
As I urged the two of them, not knowing when the conversation might take a turn for the worse, Tsukasa's hand, which had been connected, loosened.
"Hey, hey, Tsukasa-chan, are you free after this?"
Just as our fingers were about to intertwine with a hint of reluctance, Kuzunoha called out to Tsukasa from across me.
Why were they both surrounding me like it was the most natural thing in the world...?
"Sorry, I'm planning to go to Iori-kun's place today."
"Ah, then can I come too, Iori-kun? I promise I won't do anything weird."
"Eh, no thanks."
That addition was definitely a trap.
"—Iori-kun, that's a really terrible way to refuse..."
"I told you, I was also pretty hurt by that."
"Tsukasa-san, are you perhaps holding a grudge?"
"I'm not holding a grudge, but I want to reduce the number of people who go through the same thing."
That felt like a dark implication that I was treated poorly...!
"Geez, you two are flirting again."
"Why do you think that... Also, could you stop trying to hold my hand?"
Why did she try to hold my hand as if it were the most natural thing? The positioning was all wrong.
Switching places with Tsukasa, Kuzunoha casually linked arms with her.
It was better than being sandwiched, but it still felt off...
"Tsukasa-chan, are you going to have sex today?"
"What are you suddenly saying...?"
"Exactly, so just hold back."
"Tsukasa-san, you don't have to answer that; it's inappropriate."
It was indeed the plan, but I wished she would at least be vague about it.
"Eh, is that okay? Can you let me join in a little?"
"Why would I agree to that...?"
"I told you before, I don't plan to share Iori-kun with anyone, so give up."
"Then just watching is fine! Just watching should be okay, right?"
"Why are you so persistent...?"
And Tsukasa, please stop giving me that "What will you do?" look.
Why did it feel like I was considering it?
As I once again declared a one-week ban on Kuzunoha's advances, Tsukasa issued a more serious warning.
I hoped this would finally make her lose interest in bothering me...
